title: DAY 5 of having to much fun creating my "slop"game (snakes in space)
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
So the build is ALMOST ready for a few days of playtesting 

Snakes now looks so much better with shadows !

Added 2 additional game modes 

Gravity = central orbs pull all snakes in , so that you can use the momentum to slingshot to the other side (biggest snake wins after time runs out)

Bounce = There is many objects that you are able to bounce off, you also have a charge skill that makes you spring forward much faster 

  
going to spend another couple of hours just cleaning up and profiling performance before i set it live on ichio !

Only ai models used for this was purely open weight from opencode.  
  
   
Still did quite some manual work in between to just speed up the process such as   
Manually integrated a sdk for future platform  
Manually integrated and added the localization for spanish, french, portuguese and english   
Did all the tweaking and adjustments, of things like optimization draw methods , drawing the skins in asperite and clear directions of implementation from brainstorming fun new ideas 

  
and i have many more ideas to try out in this snakes game !!!!!



but yea this is the power of cheap models with good documentation :)
